data.name: Sureshkumar
data.gender_notes: Sureshkumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sureshkumar is a combination of two Sanskrit words – ‘Suresh’ and ‘Kumar’. Suresh means ‘secure, fearless, and victorious’, while Kumar means ‘young boy, or prince’. Thus, Sureshkumar signifies someone who is a secure, fearless, and victorious young boy or prince. The name Sureshkumar carries the meaning “Fortune Bringer, Secure One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit, Malayalam. Parents who choose Sureshkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody fortune bringer, secure one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sureshkumar is a powerful name that resonates with the energy of the divine deity Lord Vishnu. The name embodies the qualities of strength, loyalty, and prosperity, making it an ideal choice for parents looking to give their child a name that reflects spiritual and emotional depth.

He was a prolific writer and contributed many articles to various publications, advocating for Indian independence and social justice.

He made significant contributions to the fields of number theory, algebraic geometry, and combinatorics. Sureshkumar was a professor at the University of Madras and the Indian Statistical Institute. He was a fellow of the Indian Academy of Sciences and the National Academy of Sciences, India. He received numerous awards and recognitions for his work, including the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize in Mathematical Sciences.
